name: pf-mod-waygates
about: mod-waygates against the built package qol instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Way Gates (mods/waygates: HWP/WayGates) through the fix_waygates bot, in town as the host: `hwp waygates` lists the square's gate first and one per built building; a hwp_waygate unit stands at each listed spot; using the square's gate opens HWPWayGateMenu with one button per gate, the square's greyed; pressing the last gate's button closes the menu and puts the player on it; after a building upgrade reloads the town the gates are back. Shots: waygate-square, waygate-menu, waygate-arrived, waygate-<id>.
